head.t: Lindsay Leg Clubs: People and communities at winter time: A Leg Club philosophy
head.x: As the autumn welcomes another turn of the season, we often find a brief time to reflect on the year to date and the months ahead. The winter period can be a challenging time for people at any age across the country as the days grow shorter and the evenings darker.
